title: Tokyo Revengers
native_title: 東京卍リベンジャーズ
source: Tokyo Revengers manga by Ken Wakui (278 chapters, ended 2022), to the final happy timeline.
world: Down-on-his-luck Takemichi Hanagaki learns his middle-school girlfriend Hinata was killed in a gang war. He discovers he can leap back twelve years and joins the Tokyo Manji Gang (Toman), led by the unbeatable Mikey and his vice-president Draken, to change the future. Every leap fixes one tragedy and creates another, until a final leap lets him save everyone. Delinquent gang fights with a big heart.
power_system: No powers except Takemichi's time leaps, triggered by a handshake with Naoto Tachibana (later his own will). Fights are street brawls; Mikey's kicks are legendary.

places.name: Mikey's garage
places.line: Where Mikey's late brother Shinichiro's bikes are kept.

groups.name: Tokyo Manji Gang (Toman)
groups.line: Mikey's gang, founded to protect each other.

groups.name: Valhalla
groups.line: Rival gang in the Bloody Halloween fight.

terms.line: Takemichi's power to return to the past.

timeline.summary: Takemichi saves Draken from being stabbed.
Mikey and Takemichi leap back to 1998 together; everyone is saved, Shinichiro included; Takemichi marries Hinata.

verify: What Mikey and Draken do as adults in the final timeline (e.g. bike shop, racing)
